title: Hot Stamping Foil for Metallic Paperboard

seo.title: Hot Stamping Foil for Metallic Paperboard

content:
Metallic paperboard already has a reflective surface, so foil selection is mainly about contrast, visibility and surface compatibility.

## Why Contrast Matters

Gold foil on gold board may not stand out. Silver foil on silver board can also look weak if the tone and gloss are too similar. In many cases, matte foil, pigment foil, black foil or holographic foil can create a clearer logo.

## Surface Compatibility

Metallic board may have a special coating on the top surface. The foil should be tested on the actual board, not on ordinary paper.

## How to Choose

Compare foil colors under real lighting. For subtle luxury, choose a close tone with a different finish. For readability, choose stronger contrast.

## Testing Advice

Test the final logo, small text and one solid area. Check color contrast, adhesion and rub resistance.

## FAQ

### Should I use gold foil on gold board?

Only if the logo remains visible enough.

### Why is my logo hard to see?

The foil tone may be too close to the base board.
